title: manim-studio render manifest
description: Per-render metadata written to renders/<slug>/manifest.json by both the OSS plugin and the SaaS Video Studio. Every field except output_url/output_path is populated at save time; the output field is populated when the render completes.

slug.description: URL-safe folder name. Also the manim media_dir subfolder.

title.description: Human-readable label. Defaults to slug if not provided.

scene_class.description: The Manim Scene subclass name defined in scene.py.

quality.description: Render quality tier. OSS uses l/m/h; SaaS uses 720p/1080p/1440p; both accepted.

scene_path.description: Path to the source scene.py (relative to workspace root on SaaS, absolute on OSS local disk).

script_path.description: Path to the approved storyboard script.md, if provided.

output_url.description: SaaS: signed Azure Blob URL to the rendered mp4 (24h TTL). OSS: file:// path or absolute local path.

output_path.description: Filesystem path to the mp4 (OSS: absolute local; SaaS: workspace-relative).

thumbnail_url.description: Signed URL to the thumbnail (SaaS) or file path (OSS).

render_command.description: OSS only: the exact manim CLI command used. SaaS renders via HTTPS so this is null.

expected_video.description: OSS pre-render prediction of where manim will drop the mp4.

duration_ms.description: Total wall-clock render time (including upload for SaaS).

manim_ms.description: Just the manim invocation time; excludes SaaS-side blob upload.

session_id.description: SaaS only: the chat id this render belongs to.

credits_charged.description: SaaS only: op-class credits debited on successful render.

status.description: Lifecycle: saved (before render), rendering, completed, failed, fixed_and_rerendered (retry succeeded).

notes.description: Reviewer verdict or human notes. One or two lines.
